meaning: Full means the stated result is represented by the identified Lean statements. Partial identifies an exact component or finite witness, not proof of the full manuscript claim.

entries.label: lem:transpose
entries.title: Transposition
entries.scope: Exact proper-coloring equivalence, equivalence of excluded side lengths and equality of the least positive thresholds are checked for all natural k and side lengths.

entries.label: prop:counts
entries.title: Exact source counts
entries.scope: All identities count actual finite integer cells, fibers, corners and ordered equal-difference quadruples. The equal-sum energy convention is separately bridged.

entries.label: lem:restriction
entries.title: Diagonal exclusion and weak restriction
entries.scope: The exact stated lemma is formalized: square-to-source domain restriction, properness, diagonal-color avoidance, and the inherited weak-source map with its diagonal values. The manuscript lemma does not assert a separate palette cardinality formula.

entries.label: lem:golomb
entries.title: Golomb classes and pair sums
entries.scope: Both weak-source diagonal and inherited fiber classes are Golomb. Ordered representatives of unordered pair sums are unique, including repeated endpoints. All integer sets and coordinates are quantified.

entries.label: cor:span
entries.title: Energy to span
entries.scope: Actual difference support, intrinsic integer span and Cauchy inequality give the pair bound and both cardinality bounds for every real nonnegative kappa.

entries.label: thm:energy
entries.title: Two-Golomb accounting
entries.scope: Actual same-orientation collision bijections and opposing incidences prove all resource bounds, both corner branches and the energy bound for arbitrary disjoint Golomb classes.

entries.label: cor:imbalance
entries.title: Unequal class sizes
entries.scope: Both eta-corrected corner branches, energy and both stability conclusions follow from actual Q and common-difference deficits, including empty-class cases.

entries.label: cor:moments
entries.title: Fibers and cube moments
entries.scope: Actual ordered positive and signed cube parameters, vertex membership, recurrences, all moment identities and deficit bounds, and both Cauchy moment inequalities on the exact finite ranges. D/P/R agree with the common fiber definitions.

entries.label: prop:small-class-deficit-dominance
entries.title: When the shared-difference bound is stronger
entries.scope: The actual common-difference count is bounded by each class pair count; the scalar inequality and its full fiber sum prove the stated branch comparison. Properness is unnecessary for this comparison.

entries.label: prop:74
entries.title: A weak-source sharpness limit
entries.scope: A bundled existential certificate gives a proper binary weak source, 6+6 diagonal split and exactly 74 distinct strict corners. The same literal nonnegative integer witness is proved proper over all integer coordinate triples.

entries.label: prop:29
entries.title: Failure of a separate linear deficit
entries.scope: Both difference lists are repetition-free, N=29, and the proposed upper bound is 28. Every term for h>8 is proved zero, closing the finite-sum bridge to the full positive-difference count.

entries.label: lem:capacity
entries.title: Pair capacities
entries.scope: Actual unordered two-label subsets and support sets have both binary capacity injections. The arbitrary injective real weighted cube and real Golomb set are bridged; positivity is not needed for this lemma.

entries.label: cor:occupancy
entries.title: Cube occupancy
entries.scope: Actual intersections with real weighted cubes satisfy14 and30 bounds. The noninteger-generator and integer inherited-fiber cases are both included.

entries.label: thm:fourcube
entries.title: A separated four-cube coloring
entries.scope: The complete literal four-cube coloring transfers to every positive separated generator sequence and every integer translate through a proved coefficient-relation argument.

entries.label: cor:cube-threshold
entries.title: Exact attainable cube dimension
entries.scope: Every higher-dimensional full cube has an actual injective five-face, while the actual four-cube source is properly colorable. The maximal dimension is exactly four.

entries.label: prop:cube-free-energy
entries.title: A limit of cube exclusion
entries.scope: Complete finite Bernoulli weights, cube enumeration by six-point paths, deletion of actual vertices, and a growing sequence with the exact energy exponent73/26 and factor1/2. The subsequence N=s^31 gives the same existence result. No uniform quadratic energy or linear corner bound survives even a minimum-size cutoff.

entries.label: thm:nine
entries.title: The sharp three-cube cost
entries.scope: Every injective positive integer three-cube and proper coloring has at least9 mixed corners. Every positive two-dissociated triple admits an actual coloring attaining M28,T24,mixed9,forcing15, with no generator-order restriction.

entries.label: thm:forcing
entries.title: Signed completion and physical forcing
entries.scope: The graph uses actual unordered physical edges. Edge injectivity, exact edge count, bipartiteness, fiber identity, signed imbalance, H/K completion identity and linearity, and the exact degree formula are proved from the geometric coloring.

entries.label: prop:g9
entries.title: Conditional consequence of G9
entries.scope: The stated forcing-edge bound remains a hypothesis. The actual forcing identity gives 2T<=19M and the Cauchy span consequence M<=20L, hence the weaker S21 bound on its required range.

entries.label: prop:g9-exists
entries.title: Consequences of selecting a coloring
entries.scope: The selected proper coloring and its actual graph-edge bound remain existential hypotheses; the source-invariant corner and span bounds follow.

entries.label: thm:progression
entries.title: Complete progression products
entries.scope: Actual separated-product cardinality, energy factorization and fibers prove all energy, corner and span conclusions, including the weaker two-Golomb assumption and every integer parameter case.

entries.label: thm:direct
entries.title: Complete direct sums
entries.scope: The actual separated sum, product energy, proper factor embeddings and universal overlap restrictions give all three exact bounds for every allowed pair of factor sizes. Small exceptional sizes and six-mark AP exclusion are proved.

entries.label: lem:rectangles
entries.title: Complete overlap restrictions
entries.scope: Actual product fibers yield both factor Golomb partitions. Universal7-by3 and5-by5 two-color rectangle obstructions prove both multiplicity caps on either factor.

entries.label: lem:small
entries.title: Small factors
entries.scope: Every general-size bound, AP equality implication, four-mark cap bound and six-mark proper-factor consequence is proved. The manuscript now includes the stronger universal nonprogression deficit T<=choose(n,3)-(n-2), proved by actual endpoint deletion, replacing the six-mark classification.

entries.label: thm:matching
entries.title: Translation matchings
entries.scope: Actual disjoint translates and inherited Golomb classes give every stated energy, corner and radical span bound, including empty and singleton cases. The alternate proof uses a weaker sufficient intermediate correlation bound and an algebraic fourth-root estimate, rather than the manuscript derivative calculation.

entries.label: thm:two_distance
entries.title: Two-distance representations
entries.scope: The full actual-source theorem T<=6M, M<=13L and proper squared-distance coloring is proved. Finite midpoint pairs are extracted into actual orthogonal blocks; large-block isolation, the exceptional8-pair code bound37,112q8 incidence and strong induction removal are all derived. Source-only maps extend to global maps without additional assumptions. The target may be any real inner-product space.

entries.label: thm:midpoint-three
entries.title: Midpoint multiplicity at most three
entries.scope: The actual geometric midpoint cap implies T<=2M, M<=5L and the squared-distance proper coloring. The complete graph family satisfies this literal geometric cap and has T/M tending to2; every uniform coefficient is at least2. Both numerical conclusions and optimality are included.

entries.label: thm:graph-source
entries.title: Sources encoded by graph edges
entries.scope: Actual arbitrary finite simple edge families are encoded by base-five marks and actual Euclidean edge indicators. Pair sums are equivalent in both directions, including repetitions. The exact4cycle count uses literal four-edge cycle sets, proved equivalent to alternating-matching encodings. Midpoint cap, properness, all cardinality/energy/corner/span claims and degenerate graphs are included.

entries.label: prop:weight-two-family
entries.title: Corner density approaching two
entries.scope: The literal complete-graph family has every stated M,T,E formula, proper coloring, the exact ratio for every r>=3 and a proved limit2. Its actual midpoint cap is proved, and every uniform coefficient is at least2.

entries.label: prop:span-r3
entries.title: From span to three colors
entries.scope: For every integer q>=1, the exact source span hypothesis implies exclusion of every proper three-coloring at 18q+1. Attained finite extrema, equivalence of actual-span and interval formulations, diagonal pigeonhole, color removal, and the numerical contradiction are all formalized.

entries.label: cor:g9-three
entries.title: Three colors under G9
entries.scope: The actual finite existential G9 hypothesis through span360 implies the complete three-color Ramsey statement at361. G9 itself is not proved.

entries.label: thm:s21three
entries.title: Three colors under S21
entries.scope: The full conditional reduction is proved with S21 as an explicit hypothesis on arbitrary finite integer sources. No proof of S21 itself is claimed or assumed as a new axiom.

entries.label: lem:shift
entries.title: Finite shift count
entries.scope: Actual mixed energy, shift intervals and triangular weights prove both inequalities for arbitrary finite integer sets, positive t and real nonnegative caps.

entries.label: thm:s21four
entries.title: Four colors under S21
entries.scope: The full98777 reduction uses actual diagonal marks, removal of one color, inherited binary fiber classes, S21 widths ell-h, integer tangents and the actual t600 shift profile. S21 remains an explicit assumption.

entries.label: prop:weights
entries.title: Integer weight certificates
entries.scope: Both 42-entry weight lists satisfy the signed integer-floor recurrence and nonnegative bound, have the exact copy totals, and satisfy all positive-integer load bounds. Recurrence uniqueness identifies the printed weights with the recursive definition. Finite kernel computation checks loads through 420; a universal support/divisibility proof makes every later load zero.

entries.label: thm:weighted
entries.title: Arithmetic of a rejected numerical route
entries.scope: The exact integer weight/load tables are cast into actual real geometric counts, with all tails proved zero. The complete conditional459/455 implications are proved. Their local premises are refuted elsewhere, so no unconditional improvement is claimed.

entries.label: lem:variance
entries.title: Three-color line identity
entries.scope: Explicit row, column and diagonal pair bijections give the exact variance identity. Integer minima give the literal floor correction in U_N, and the actual source-corner bridge is proved.

entries.label: lem:weighted
entries.title: Weighted embedding implication
entries.scope: Actual affine embeddings, exact step counts and fixed-corner parameter injectivity prove rho*J<=K*R<=K*U for arbitrary nonnegative real weights. The local rainbow assumption remains explicit.

entries.label: prop:local-rainbows
entries.title: Refutation of the two local rainbow bounds
entries.scope: Literal complete three-colorings are valid and proper for all natural coordinates, with 3 and 6 rainbow corners; both universal local assertions are refuted.

entries.label: prop:t13
entries.title: Refutation of $\F_{13}(17)$
entries.scope: Literal complete coloring is valid and proper for all natural coordinates, with 14 rainbow corners; the proposed 17-rainbow lower bound is refuted.

entries.label: lem:H
entries.title: First-coordinate reflection
entries.scope: Proper positive directed-L coloring iff its first-coordinate-reflected coloring is positive-standard-corner-free, with square domains explicit.

entries.label: lem:J
entries.title: Half-turn and paired colors
entries.scope: All N,k with k positive: paired colors use at most k^2 labels; a duplicate-free enumeration of the full square has N^2 cells; a class satisfies N^2 <= k^2 times its cardinality and excludes every nonzero signed corner.

entries.label: lem:embed
entries.title: Cyclic embedding without wraparound
entries.scope: Complete injection and corner-free image are proved for every positive N and every eligible subset of the square. The cyclic group is represented by canonical integer residues, with addition and nonzero steps modulo 2N.

entries.label: thm:general
entries.title: General bound from the external corners theorem
entries.scope: The full conditional transfer from the cited external cyclic corners estimate uses actual paired-color classes, canonical cyclic representatives, the exact exponent600, constants and ceilings. ExternalCyclicCornersBound is a named hypothesis corresponding to JLLOS25v2 Theorem1.1; that external theorem is not formalized here.

entries.label: lem:deletion
entries.title: Exact endpoint deletion
entries.scope: Actual removed-corner and arc bijections prove T(A)-T(B)=e0=2D0+P0. Reflection and the maximum-endpoint counterpart are included.

entries.label: lem:anchor
entries.title: A sharp restricted endpoint bound
entries.scope: Both anchor bounds and arbitrarily large equality examples are proved. Sharpness uses an alternative greedy Sidon construction, rather than certifying the literal base-R example in the paper proof.

entries.label: prop:peel
entries.title: Conditional endpoint reduction
entries.scope: Actual finite-set induction proves EP10 implies H10 and the stated span/S21 consequences. EP10 is retained as an explicit assumption, including its finite-range form.

additional_unformalized_inputs: The cited external quantitative corners theorem is not formalized here. The general bound explicitly takes its valid constant and estimate as hypotheses.
S21, G9, G9-exists, EP10 and H10 remain open mathematical assumptions. A conditional Lean theorem accepting one of these as a hypothesis is not a proof of that assumption.
scope_boundary: Acceptance concerns the47named manuscript statements with their stated inputs. It does not prove external cited theorems or open assertions. Standard logical axioms are disclosed in the compiler output.
